title: GaokaoMathGen: Chinese Gaokao Mathematics Finale Problem Generation Controlled by Latent Reasoning Structures
abstract: arXiv:2611.31823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problems requires controlling not only the included skills, but also the underlying mathematical kernel and solution path. Existing LLM-based methods mainly rely on surface-level specifications, while the realized difficulty of generated problems cannot be determined directly from prompted targets. Therefore, we propose GaokaoMathGen, a framework for Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problem generation controlled by latent reasoning structures. It extracts standardized latent reasoning structures from seed problems and performs constrained synthesis using skills, methods, a core identity, and a pivot step as structural controls. We further estimate realized difficulty through logical-quality filtering, fixed-solver decoding effort, structural features, and solver-output search signals. translated_title: GaokaoMathGen：基于潜在推理结构控制的中国高考数学压轴题生成
translated_abstract: 生成中国高考数学压轴题不仅需要控制题目所考查的知识技能，还需要控制其底层的数学内核与解题路径。现有的基于大语言模型的方法主要依赖表层规范，而所生成题目的实际难度无法直接从提示目标中确定。因此，我们提出了GaokaoMathGen，一个由潜在推理结构控制的中国高考数学压轴题生成框架。该框架从种子题目中提取标准化的潜在推理结构，并以技能、方法、核心恒等式和关键转折步骤作为结构控制进行约束合成。我们进一步通过逻辑质量过滤、固定求解器的解码工作量、结构特征以及求解器输出搜索信号来估计题目的实际难度。实验表明，语义规范化提升了跨标注者的可比性，且在609个评分样本中有78.0%（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GaokaoMathGen框架，通过从种子题中提取技能、方法、核心恒等式和关键转折步骤等潜在推理结构来约束生成高考数学压轴题，并结合逻辑过滤与求解器解码等多重信号估计题目实际难度。
